# Jubilees Chapter 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Pharaoh's dreams; Joseph's exaltation; Joseph's marriage

---

**40:1** And in the first year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee, Pharaoh had two dreams in the same night. And they were troubled by both of them.

**40:2** And Joseph was brought before Pharaoh, and he interpreted his two dreams. And it was established that there would be seven years of plenty throughout all the land of Egypt, and after them seven years of famine.

**40:3** And Pharaoh set Joseph over all his land and made him ruler of all Egypt. And Pharaoh said to him: "None but I shall be greater than thee in all the land of Egypt."

**40:4** And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphenath-paneah and gave to him Asenath the daughter of Potiphera the priest of Heliopolis as wife.

**40:5** And Joseph was thirty years of age when he stood before Pharaoh and went out over all the land of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh's presence and went through all the land of Egypt.

**40:6** And in the seven years of plenty Joseph gathered all the food of the land and stored it in the cities. And the seven years of famine began after the seven years of plenty.

**40:7** And famine was in all the land except Egypt. And Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians and to all the peoples of the earth.

**40:8** And the sons of Jacob came to Egypt to buy grain, for the famine was great in the land of Canaan also.

**40:9** And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him. And he spoke harshly to them and asked them about their father and their brother Benjamin.

**40:10** And they said: "Our father is alive and our younger brother is with him." And Joseph put Simeon in bonds and told them to bring Benjamin.

**40:11** And they returned to the land of Canaan and told their father Jacob all that had happened to them.

**40:12** And Jacob said: "You have bereaved me: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and you will take Benjamin also." And he refused to send Benjamin.

**40:13** And Reuben said: "My two sons shalt thou slay if I bring him not back to thee." And Jacob would not send him with Reuben.

**40:14** And Judah said to Jacob: "Send the lad with me, and I will be surety for him." And Jacob consented and sent Benjamin with his brothers.

**40:15** And they came before Joseph. And Joseph saw Benjamin his brother and wept. And he went into a chamber and wept there. And he washed his face and came out and restrained himself.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 40 compresses the Genesis 41-43 material. The verse count here is shorter than in the biblical parallel. Jubilees includes the Zaphenath-paneah name (v.4) and Asenath marriage, acknowledging the Egyptian wife while noting she is a priest's daughter. The Jacob-sons negotiations over Benjamin (vv.12-14) follow Genesis closely.*
